title: Collage de Retrato Surreal: Rostro de Mujer Diseccionado Horizontalmente en Tres Franjas
prompt: A surreal art collage portrait featuring a young woman's head horizontally dissected into three distinct, slightly misaligned strips. The aesthetic is clean, artistic, and minimalist. The woman has long, wavy, messy medium brown hair with warm caramel highlights, appearing slightly wet or textured, falling around her face. The top strip reveals the crown of her head and forehead. The middle strip focuses on her hazel/brown eyes and nose, with her visible eye gazing directly at the viewer with an intense, enigmatic expression. Subtle freckles are visible across her nose and cheek, and her eyebrows are natural and full. The bottom strip features her slightly parted, full lips with natural pinkish-brown hue, her chin, jawline, and neck, with a small silver earring visible on her left ear and a faint beauty mark on her neck. From the left side, a fair-skinned hand enters with index finger extended, pointing directly at the middle strip of the woman's face. She is wearing a textured, light-colored (white or off-white) knitted or crocheted sweater. Close-up portrait composition with woman's head centered and slightly angled upwards. Soft, diffused, natural lighting creating subtle shadows. Muted warm color palette dominated by natural skin tones, warm brown for hair, off-white for sweater, against plain solid very light pale pinkish-beige background. Artistic and subtly contemplative mood. Sharp, clean horizontal cuts emphasizing meticulously crafted physical assemblage effect.
